mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, it is 48 degrees with clear skies observed near the Verona Public Library and a first quarter moon visible.

City news today includes a report from the police department regarding an arrest on Thursday, plus reminders about checking the new interactive zoning maps and your updated polling locations for upcoming elections.
You have plenty to look forward to including yoga today, followed by a full schedule of trivia and live music tomorrow through the rest of the week.
On Thursday, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired, noting that no injuries occurred and the investigation is ongoing.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and you can head over to Culver's when they open today at 10:00 AM.
